sentences.text:
---- 
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH KUMAR ----

For the Petitioner/Applicant : Mr. K.S. Nanda, Adv. For the State : Mr. Santosh Kr. Shukla, A.P.P.
----
th 02/Dated: 20 January, 2023 1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant who is in custody since 05.05.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Angara P.S. Case No.177 of 2020 corresponding to G.R. Case No.1480 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 409 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code but subsequently it was corrected and made it under Sections 406 and 420 of the IPC.
3. It appears that the applicant is accused of not returning the vehicle obtained through an agreement.

4. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his part.
5. Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
Further, it has been submitted that the vehicle in question has already been returned and this statement has been made in para-9 of the application.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.

sentences.text:
6. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
7.

Considering the above facts, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi in connection with Angara P.S. Case No.177 of 2020 corresponding to G.R. Case No.1480 of 2022, subject to condition that the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
